integrity: Finite verification code is included and replayed; no independent or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Complete zero-eigenvalue Jordan partition and first-entry counts only for open square grids over finite fields of characteristic two. Primitive periods on the invertible sector and nonsquare rectangles are not classified. Older Sutner (2000) and Hunziker–Machiavelo–Park (2004) full texts were inaccessible, so historical priority is subject to this explicit risk. An earlier special-case calculation for side lengths one less than a power of two is excluded from the originality claim. Computational checks are finite and the proof supplies all-size validity.
title: Two-adic transient stratification for square-grid parity dynamics
